answer: Anyone running 195 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in timber, expire in kernel, and wharf lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4773 identities would post 2921 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
